key.description: One policy leaf: retention.<kind>, sensitivity.<kind>, thresholds.<name>, scripts.<timeout_seconds|log_bytes|output_files|output_file_bytes>, packs, models.careful, demo.simulated_until, open_weights.<endpoint|model|kind|label>, or the whole open_weights block. Secrets, other whole mappings and open_weights.capabilities/verified_at (written only by office.private-route-check) are refused. Calendar leaves: calendar.connection, calendar.window_days_past, calendar.window_days_ahead, calendar.prep_lead_minutes, calendar.prep_max_per_run.

value.description: Typed JSON value, validated for the selected key. Retention is 1–36500 days or null; sensitivity is normal/private; packs is a distinct list of meetings/receipts; thresholds are bounded positive integers; scripts bounds are positive integers up to timeout_seconds=1800, log_bytes=1048576, output_files=8, output_file_bytes=1048576; open_weights is a mapping of endpoint (an HTTPS base URL, or HTTP(S) on loopback; never api.meta.ai), model, kind (company, provider or own_hardware) and label, or null. demo.simulated_until is a YYYY-MM-DD date, or null to clear it. Changing the endpoint or model clears the recorded capabilities. models.careful is a nonempty ASCII model slug of at most 128 bytes (letters, digits, -._/:); the default is muse-wonder. Calendar: connection is 1–48 ASCII letters, digits, _ or - (null clears it); window_days_past/ahead are 1–90; prep_lead_minutes 15–1440; prep_max_per_run 1–20.
